Base Appearance

General

New
I'll make desserts that can make all Cookies happy!
Cookie Info & Loading
I... I can sense the ingredients in this dessert...! I... I've got it! I figured out how to make this dessert!
Dear Baking fairy! Please make this a delicious dessert! When baking, it's the heart that counts!
One bite of tasty desserts can make anyone happy! A sweet dessert always helps when the world's got you feeling bitter!
I hope my desserts bring a smile to Cookies' faces! I want to make desserts that give Cookies courage and comfort!
I wanna win, no matter what! I'll do my best! I'll do even better in the next round!
Tired
My best... wasn't enough...

Lobby

Daily Reward
Are you feeling a bit happier today? I hope you are, at least!
Tap
I need to get better...! I won't be able to win with my skills as they are. I'm going to give it my all in this next round!
It may not be the fanciest... but I wanted to make a dessert that I could put my heart into! I haven't been making desserts for long, but I work extra hard to make up for it!
Hehe, I'm going to be a pâtissier that brings happiness to Cookies with my desserts! Once I was so focused on baking late into the night that I got locked inside my school, hehe...
I want to open my own pastry shop! I even know what I want to name it, hehe! What does it take for a dessert to truly move a Cookie's heart...? I have to figure it out to win...
You're my fan..? Thank you so much! I'll make sure to win. I hope that Bread Fairy sticks with me even if I win...!
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Great Pâtissier Battle Set Lobby This is just the beginning...! Deep breaths... You can do it, Angel Chiffon Cookie!
When placed in a Lobby with Everything Pie Cookie,  Bountiful Pie Day, or  Dreamy Pie Pâtissière Why don't my desserts taste the way I want them to even when I follow my heart while baking...?
Gift
Neutral I'm not so sure this will go well in my cake...
Given Magic Piping Bag Yay, I can make even more desserts now!
Given Royal Golden Dough Wowww! It almost feels like I was just handed the winning trophy!

 Strawberry Festival Mascot

Reused quotes are marked with an asterisk.

General

Cookie Info & Loading
This is my first time baking for a dessert festival myself! I picked a cake that hopefully should help the ingredients shine!
I put extra love into making the strawberry decorations... Can you tell? When baking, it's the heart that counts! *
It tastes magical, like a fairy made it? Hehe... I wonder if it's listening. A sweet dessert always helps when the world's got you feeling bitter! *
I want to make desserts that give Cookies courage and comfort! * I hope my desserts bring a smile to Cookies' faces! *
One bite of a tasty dessert can make anyone happy! * It may look simple, but I promise the flavor isn't!
Tired
The festival's over...?

Lobby

Daily Reward
Your smile when eating desserts is the best reward for me!
Tap
Wow, thanks for choosing my cake from all the desserts here! I wanted to pick something that was simple but not so boring that you'd get tired of it!
I made the dessert that called to me, regardless of what the voting outcome may be! I was baking, and when I looked up at out customers they were all smiling! It made me so happy.
You ate an entire strawberry cream cake on your own?! Thank you for enjoying it! We're running low on strawberries? But... I can't just make plain cream cakes...
I can never hold back at dessert buffets! It's not just me... right? Hehe... I want to try the other desserts prepared by the other pâtissiers... I'll ask to share later!
I was invited to participate in another dessert festival! If these cakes do have a magic spell on them, I hope it's a spell that makes Cookies happy!
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Great Pâtissier Battle Set Lobby *Gasp* Oh my gosh, I was just selected to judge the strawberry desserts!
When placed in a Lobby with  Grass Leaf Cafe I hope I can open just as cozy of a cafe in the future!
Gift
Neutral Oh, I appreciate it! But I'll take it once the festival's over...
Given Magic Piping Bag I'll make a cake with all my heart, that's almost like casting a magic spell on it!
Given Royal Golden Dough It'll look even better with a strawberry on top!
